answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in anchor, expire in cipher, and sparrow lists each expiry. Someone running 135 aliases thus needs 46 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4751 identities would post 2381 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
